videos.title: What If Green Didn't Exist? 🌲➡️⚫
videos.description:
If green light vanished from the universe, every forest would turn black, the sky would glow pink, and Earth might freeze over. But the trees would keep growing. Here's why.

#whatif #science #green #physics #shorts

videos.description:
A dial on your wrist that turns your weight down. At half you bounce up the stairs, at a tenth you jump onto roofs, and below 80 grams you float away like a balloon.

#whatif #science #gravity #physics #shorts

videos.description:
A second face on the back of your head means no blind spot, no mirrors, and nobody can ever sneak up on you. But nature already ran this experiment, and the answer is surprising.

#whatif #science #biology #evolution #shorts

videos.title: What If Everyone on Earth Ground Their Teeth at the Same Time? 😬
videos.description:
Eight billion people, one countdown, everyone grinds. Would the planet roar? Would Earth shake? The real answer is quieter, and it is already happening every night.

videos.title: What If the Train Came After You? 🚂🐎
videos.description:
You rob a train and ride where no train can follow. So the railroad sends the horses by train.

Just so you know: the outlaw in this story is made up, and it combines two real Wyoming robberies from 1899 and 1900, but the Union Pacific really did build train cars to carry posses and their horses.

#whatif #wildwest #history #train #shorts

videos.title: What If You Invaded Switzerland? 🇨🇭💥
videos.description:
You invade Switzerland for its tunnels, and the Swiss blow up their own country.

Just so you know: the invasion in this story is made up. The fake houses with painted windows, the rigged bridges and the demolition plan were real: the plan dates from 1940, and the army finished taking the charges out in 2014.

#whatif #switzerland #history #shorts

videos.title: What If You Sank Your Own Submarine? 🌊
videos.description:
You sink a hundred million dollars on purpose, and the people hunting you have to save your life.

Just so you know: the captain in this story is made up. Crews really did sink their boats and get rescued, and since 2008 US law treats the boat itself as a crime, with up to 15 years in prison.

Plane model: "Small Airplane" by Vojtěch Balák (https://poly.pizza/m/7cvx6ex-xfL), CC BY 3.0, modified.

#whatif #submarine #coastguard #shorts

videos.title: What If You Had to Tip for Everything? 💸
videos.description:
The door just asked you for twenty percent.

Just so you know: the tipping objects are made up. The $2.13 tipped base wage is real US federal law, unchanged since 1991, as long as tips bring the worker up to the full minimum wage.

#whatif #tipping #money #shorts

videos.title: What If Your Salary Floated Over Your Head? 💰
videos.description:
This morning, a number floats over every head on your street, including yours.

Just so you know: the floating numbers are made up. Norway really did put everyone's income online in 2001, the happiness gap between richer and poorer people grew 29 % (Perez-Truglia, American Economic Review, 2020), and today people can see who looked them up.

#whatif #salary #norway #money #shorts

videos.title: What If a Tornado Picked You Up? 🌪️
videos.description:
A storm tears the walls off your trailer, and then it takes you.

Just so you know: "you" stands in for a real person. In March 2006, Matt Suter of Missouri was carried 1,307 feet by a tornado and lived, the farthest on record according to Guinness World Records. Some small details are dramatized.

#whatif #tornado #weather #truestory #shorts

videos.title: What If You Dropped a Frozen Turkey in a Fryer? 🦃🔥
videos.description:
This turkey is about to become a bomb, and you are holding it.

Just so you know: the story is made up and the fireball is a cartoon. The facts are real: ice on a turkey turns to steam in hot oil, and at 100 °C steam takes up about 1,700 times the volume of the water (Alabama Fire College). NFPA counted an estimated 1,446 home cooking fires on Thanksgiving Day 2023, about 4.9 times an average day, and strongly discourages oil turkey fryers. If you cook a turkey this year, thaw it all the way and keep hot oil far from the house.

#whatif #thanksgiving #turkey #firesafety #shorts

videos.title: What If America Never Bought Alaska? 🇺🇸
videos.description:
Russia sold this for two cents an acre. Now tear up the cheque.

Just so you know: the story is made up; the facts are real. The US paid $7.2 million for Alaska in 1867, about two cents an acre, and newspapers called it "Seward's Folly". Gold was found at Nome in 1898, and the Trans-Alaska Pipeline has moved over 18 billion barrels of oil. Russian Alaska, its border with Canada and the Cold War planes are our guess at the other timeline.

#whatif #history #alaska #alternatehistory #shorts

videos.title: What If Every Word Cost Money? 💸
videos.description:
In this town, "I love you" costs three dollars, and the narrator's words come out of the same meter.

Just so you know: this story is made up. No real town charges for words, and no real guide box runs out of money mid-sentence. The prices, Talkton and Mia are all invented for the joke.

#whatif #funny #cartoon #story #shorts
